request: Analyze GSE120958 for PMID 30612451 (High-Phosphate Diet Induces Exercise Intolerance and Impairs Fatty Acid Metabolism in Mice.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Effect of 12-week high-phosphate diet (2% Pi, HP) vs normal-phosphate diet (0.6% Pi, NP) on gastrocnemius gene expression (S4.4.p1, FIG5). Exercise is a phenotypic outcome (treadmill capacity, S4.2.p2), not a factor of the RNA-seq design.
final.sample_inclusion: n = 3 per diet group, male C57BL/6, 20-24 weeks old (FIG5, S2.2.p1); no exercise state is stated for the sequenced animals; related mitochondria assays are explicitly from non-exercised mice (FIG4 legend)
planned_contrasts: HP vs NP diet (S4.4.p1, FIG5; paper: 'over 5,000' DEGs)
final.paper_results: over 5,000 DEGs HP vs NP (S4.4.p1); down: Fabp4, Fabp5, Lipe (Hsl), Fasn, Pparg, Adipoq, Pnpla3; up: Gck, Hk2, Pgk1, Irs2, Ldha, Slc2a4 (Glut4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.13.p1 deposits GSE120958 for muscle RNA-seq. S4.4.p1/FIG5 analyze HPD vs normal chow (n=3/group) with DESeq2, 'cutoff values of +/-1.5 fold change and P < 0.05' (raw P stated). Exercise appears only as treadmill phenotyping (S2.7, S4.2) and blood measures; no RNA-seq arm is exercised vs sedentary.

checks: GEO: gastrocnemius, C57BL/6, 12-week diet, 3 NP + 3 HP matches FIG5 n=3/group

ownership.reasoning: Paper names the accession; tissue, strain, diet doses and group sizes agree.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns NP_1..HP_3 equal metadata title exactly (6/6). grp derived from title; agrees with characteristics diet column.

matrix.reasoning: GSE120958_countTable.txt.gz is 100% integer, max 1.5e6; data_processing: featureCounts quantification, 'Tab-delimited text files include raw counts and FPKM values'. Paper input to DESeq2 is raw counts, consistent.

candidates.reason_rejected: This is a dietary phosphate contrast, not exercise; neither arm is exercised or trained and no exercise-state variable exists in GEO or the paper's RNA-seq description. Relabelling diet as 'exercise intolerance' would misstate the estimand.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE120958 contains only normal- vs high-phosphate diet gastrocnemius samples (3 vs 3), all of unstated/non-exercised state. Exercise in the paper is a phenotypic outcome (treadmill capacity), not a factor of the sequenced design, so the data cannot identify an effect of exercise on gene expression.
design.reasoning: Request asks how exercise affects gene expression. S4.4.p1/FIG5: the only RNA-seq comparison is HPD vs normal chow; GEO grouping column is diet only (normal phosphate 3, high phosphate 3); diet time 12 weeks constant. No exercise arm, no pre/post exercise timepoint.

discrepancies.paper: Title/abstract emphasise exercise intolerance; RNA-seq contrast is diet only (S4.4.p1)
